title: Anthracite-Coke
description: Anthracite & Coke adds fuel variants to 1.20.6 giving you more efficient smelting options beyond standard coal.
body:
Anthracite & Coke (1.20.6)

Anthracite & Coke expands Minecraft’s fuel system by adding a bit more variety to coal deposits and a simple way to upgrade your fuel. It doesn’t replace vanilla coal it just adds Anthracite as a rarer find that can show up mixed into normal coal veins (and sometimes in its own small pockets), plus Coke as a refined fuel you can make when you’ve got a Blast Furnace.

Features

Anthracite
A natural coal variant that spawns alongside vanilla coal. It burns longer than regular coal (2400 ticks).

Coke
A higher-efficiency fuel made by processing coal / charcoal / anthracite in a Blast Furnace only. Burns even longer (3200 ticks).

Blocks included
Anthracite Block + Coke Block (9 item ↔ 1 block).

Anthracite and Coke also count as “coal” for the usual crafting uses (torches, campfires, etc.), so they fit into vanilla recipes naturally.
